# Why Disability Support Matters in Kenya: Facts, Challenges & How to Help Millions of Kenyans live with disabilities, facing daily challenges that most of us never consider. Here’s the bigger picture—and how you can help. ## 🇰🇪 The Disability Landscape in Kenya - 👥 Over 3 million Kenyans live with disabilities - ♿ Limited access to assistive devices and mobility aids - 🏥 Gaps in affordable, accessible healthcare - 🏫 Barriers to inclusive education - 💼 High unemployment and economic exclusion ## 📊 Key Statistics - ♿ 60% lack access to assistive devices like wheelchairs - 📉 80%+ unemployment among disabled adults in many regions - 🏫 Thousands of children excluded due to inaccessible schools - 🏗️ Public infrastructure often lacks ramps and accessible facilities ## 🏗️ Systemic Challenges Infrastructure, social stigma, and economic barriers create a perfect storm of difficulty for disabled Kenyans: - 🚧 Inaccessible buildings and transport - 🧠 Social stigma and discrimination - 💸 Poverty cycles reinforced by limited opportunities - 🏛️ Insufficient government funding and services ## 🤝 Your Impact: What Donations Can Do - ♿ Provide durable wheelchairs and mobility aids - 🏥 Fund medical care, therapy, and medications - 🧑‍🏫 Support inclusive education and skills training - 🏠 Improve accessibility for safe, dignified living ## 🌟 Real Change Starts With You Together, we can turn systemic barriers into bridges of opportunity. Even modest monthly support can transform day-to-day life for someone living with a disability. ![Mary & Lydia](/images/marylydia.png) #### Lydia's Story
